source.notes: No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Printed: Maximum marks 70, three hours plus 15 minutes reading time; 8 printed pages; footer code '1219-862A' on every page (recorded as paperCode). No lettered sections are printed: Question 1 (20 marks: (a) 4×1 fill in the blanks, (b) 4×1 MCQ, (c) 4×1 matching, (d) 4×2 short answers), Questions 2-8 (2 marks each), 9-15 (3 marks each), 16-18 (5 marks each). Internal choice (OR) in Questions 2, 7, 9, 13, 16, 17 and 18, entered as (a)/(b) alternatives sharing a choiceGroup. The matching item 1(c) is split into its four 1-mark items, each repeating the column-B list. Where one bracket covers independent sub-parts that divide evenly (Questions 3, 4, 5, 11, 14, 15) they are split with an assumed even mark split (marksSource SECTION_INSTRUCTIONS); Question 12 ((i) two names, (ii) four parts) is kept together. The text layer flattens subscripts, superscripts and charges and drops some arrows, Δ signs and reagents over arrows; these were rebuilt in Unicode from the rendered pages and flagged per question. The table in Question 2(a) is not reproduced. The 2019 syllabus included topics (solid state, surface chemistry, metallurgy, p-block elements, polymers, chemistry in everyday life) that have no chapter in the current ISC list; those questions have chapter null.
